newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian court sentences belltower raiders.
newsitem.headline: Italian court sentences belltower raiders.

text.p: An Italian court on Wednesday jailed eight separatists who stormed the belltower in Venice's St Mark's Square in a bizarre independence demonstration in May for up to six years.

Court president Graziana Campanato handed down sentences of six years to four of the men and four years and nine months to the other four after spending seven hours in a closed session with a panel of six lay judges.
The eight men were also ordered to pay 150 million lire ($88,000) in damages to the Venice town council.
The eight, almost all in their 20s and 30s, broke into the belltower during the night after hijacking a ferry to take them and a home-made armoured vehicle to the square in the lagoon city.
Defending lawyers had pleaded for leniency after state prosecutor Rita Ugolini last week demanded sentences of up to nine years in jail.
The four jailed for six years were immediately remanded in custody while the other four men were placed under house arrest.
